systemic_note: The 26.1.2 tree inherits the 26.1.1 regression wholesale: it carries 26.3-form code in files where the 26.1 tree carries corrected forms (items.rs, brewing.rs, providers.rs, menu.rs, block_entity_nbt.rs, block_entity_item.rs, sign_edit.rs, composter.rs, level/sculk.rs, dispenser.rs, spawner.rs, trial_spawner.rs, lan_stations.rs, save.rs, recipe_book.rs, machines.rs - all byte-identical to 26.1.1's). The mechanism is one pattern: component/tag reads for data that does not exist in 26.1.2 (cooking_fuel, brewing_fuel, villager_food, compostable, mob_visibility, sign_text_front/back, waxed components; sculk_growth_inhibitors, extendable_maps tags). Where the 26.1 tree replaced those reads with the 26.1-form source (hardcoded tables, tag checks, FuelValues), the 26.1.1/26.1.2 trees read the absent component/tag and get nothing. Consequence: two 1.21.7 majors that 26.1 had FIXED are still back (G01 furnaces never light, G02 brewing stands never brew), and the 8 defects G30-G37 are still present. Vanilla 26.1.2 == vanilla 26.1.1 for every Batch 4 class (PORT-NOTES-26.1.2.md: the 6 changed classes are handleAttack/Checkbox/AbstractReportScreen/DetectedVersion/SharedConstants), so every difference is a port-side inheritance, not a vanilla change.
